# 04 Render a core sequence diagram to SVG

## Outcome

A new `renderSequenceToSVG(diagram)` builds the SVG tree for the core subset: participant boxes
and actor stick-figure icons, lifelines, all ten message arrow-marker/dash combinations, message
labels, title, and autonumber labels — per the SVG conventions frozen in spec.md. Block frames and
box-group backgrounds are added by tickets 09/14 on top of this same file.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `renderSequenceToSVG` on a hand-built core `PositionedSequenceDiagram` produces one
  `<g class="siren-participant" data-siren-id="{id}">` per participant — a `<rect>`+`<text>` for
  `kind: "participant"`, a stick-figure `<g>` (head + body/arm/leg lines, per spec) + `<text>` for
  `kind: "actor"`.
- [ ] One `<line class="siren-lifeline" data-siren-id="{id}">` per participant, spanning its full
  computed extent.
- [ ] One `<g class="siren-message" data-siren-id="{id}">` per message, containing a
  `<path class="siren-message-arrow">` whose `marker-start`/`marker-end` and `stroke-dasharray`
  match its `{ line, head }` — all ten combinations covered by distinct `<marker>` defs in
  `<defs>`, and a `<text class="siren-message-label">` with the message text.
- [ ] When autonumbering was active for a message (per `PositionedMessage`'s data), an adjacent
  `<text class="siren-autonumber">` renders its sequence number; messages without it render none.
- [ ] `title`, when present on the diagram, renders exactly one `<text class="siren-title">`; when
  absent, no such element exists.
- [ ] All text (message labels, participant labels, title) is set via `textContent`; a label
  containing `<script>`/HTML-looking text renders as literal visible text.

## Test seam

`renderSequenceToSVG(diagram: PositionedSequenceDiagram): SVGSVGElement` — component test under
Vitest's jsdom environment (real DOM), hand-built `PositionedSequenceDiagram` fixtures.
